big_story.headline: RBI Holds Rates Steady
big_story.subhead: RBI HOLDS REPO RATE UNCHANGED AND PROJECTS 6.9% REAL GDP GROWTH FOR CURRENT FISCAL YEAR
paragraphs: The Reserve Bank of India has decided to keep the key repo rate unchanged while projecting the country's real GDP growth for the current fiscal year at 6.9%. The central bank's policy announcement delivers benchmark stability for domestic financial markets and commercial lending. Meanwhile, Indian equity benchmarks opened on a cautious note today, with the Sensex opening 100 points lower and the Nifty falling below 25,900.

The decision to maintain borrowing costs comes as policy makers evaluate broader macroeconomic conditions and global market shifts. By keeping the benchmark interest rate level, the central bank seeks to support ongoing expansion while managing monetary stability. The projected 6.9% economic growth rate highlights confidence in domestic momentum despite international headwinds.

For financial institutions and corporate borrowers, maintaining current policy settings prevents immediate increases in debt servicing costs. Market participants will monitor upcoming inflation and growth readings to assess future trajectory decisions by the central bank. With the GDP forecast set at 6.9%, focus shifts to commercial credit demand and domestic consumption trends.
big_story.pullbox: By keeping the repo rate unchanged and maintaining a 6.9% real GDP growth projection for the current fiscal year, the Reserve Bank of India reinforces domestic economic stability amid broader global market shifts.

explains.title: What is the Repo Rate?
paragraphs: The repo rate is the key interest rate at which the central bank lends short-term money to commercial banks against government securities. It acts as the primary tool for controlling liquidity and setting borrowing costs across the economy.

When the central bank keeps the repo rate unchanged, commercial banks typically hold their benchmark interest rates steady. This stabilizes loan interest rates for businesses and consumers across the banking network.

Design-Linked Incentive (DLI) scheme-backed startup C2i Semiconductors has raised $15 million in a funding round led by Peak XV. The transaction represents the largest single venture capital investment round raised by an Indian chip startup.

The substantial capital injection underscores rising investor appetite for India's domestic semiconductor hardware and chip design ecosystem. Backed by Peak XV and government support under the DLI framework, C2i Semiconductors plans to accelerate its technical development and expansion.

story_1.headline: NSE Obtains RBI Approval for Corporate Bond Futures
paragraphs: The National Stock Exchange of India has secured approval from the Reserve Bank of India to launch corporate bond index futures. This regulatory nod follows clearance previously granted by SEBI in October.
Market participants are now awaiting the announcement of an official launch date for the derivative contract, which aims to deepen liquidity in the domestic debt market.

story_2.headline: IiAS Seeks SEBI Scrutiny on ₹28,000 Crore Steel Deal
paragraphs: Proxy advisory firm Institutional Investor Advisory Services has approached market regulator SEBI seeking intervention in the proposed ₹28,000 crore transaction between APL Apollo and Tata Steel.
The move introduces heightened regulatory scrutiny into one of the year's largest industrial arrangements as stakeholders assess the firm's governance concerns.

story_3.headline: Nvidia Demands Clash With South Korea Workweek Cap
paragraphs: Semiconductor giant Nvidia's strict mandate requiring corporate partners to resolve technical issues within 24 hours has hit a bottleneck in South Korea. Local R&D teams are struggling to comply with the tight turnaround while operating under the country's legally mandated 52-hour weekly work limit.

geopolitics.headline: Manila Summits Target Indo-Pacific Geopolitical Stability
paragraphs: Diplomats and leaders have converged in Manila for the ASEAN-India Summit alongside the Quad summit, centering discussions on stabilizing Indo-Pacific geopolitics. The high-level regional gatherings come as New Delhi executes a broader foreign policy shift away from traditional hesitation toward pragmatic deal-making. Strategic discussions in Manila focus on securing key maritime corridors and reinforcing economic cooperation across Southeast Asia.

For corporate India and financial markets, stability across Indo-Pacific shipping lanes is critical for sustaining trade and securing supply chains. As global trade faces headwinds from tariffs and protectionism, India's proactive engagement in Manila highlights its drive to deepen economic integration with regional partners. Investors will be monitoring how the summit outcomes strengthen regional security and safeguard international trade routes.

big_story.headline: RBI Brings Home 60 Tonnes of Gold; 84% Reserves Held Domestically
big_story.text: The Reserve Bank of India has repatriated 60 tonnes of gold holdings over the past six months, resulting in 84% of its total reserves being held domestically. This strategic shift strengthens sovereign asset security and mitigates risks associated with foreign custody during global market uncertainties.

big_story.headline: Schaeffler India Shares Surge 4% Following ₹3,543 Crore Block Deal
big_story.text: Shares of Schaeffler India jumped 4% following a massive block deal valued at ₹3,543 crore. Strong institutional interest in the automotive and industrial component maker highlights investor confidence in India's expanding manufacturing ecosystem and capital expenditure cycle.

venture_vault.headline: XEBO.ai Secures $10.5 Million Series A to Scale Customer AI Platform
venture_vault.text: Artificial intelligence startup XEBO.ai has raised $10.5 million in Series A funding to expand its AI-powered customer experience platform. The investment underscores growing investor appetite for enterprise AI software solutions emerging from India's technology ecosystem.

venture_vault.headline: SatSure Raises INR 600 Crore From Government-Backed Space Fund
venture_vault.text: Indian space tech startup SatSure has secured INR 600 crore from a government-backed space fund to scale its geospatial analytics capabilities. The capital injection highlights India's commitment to boosting private enterprise participation in deep-tech and commercial space sectors.

geopolitics.headline: US Unveils Tariffs on 14 Partners; India Faces 25% Levy Without Deal
geopolitics.text: Donald Trump has announced prospective tariffs targeting 14 trade partners, warning that India faces a 25% levy if a bilateral agreement is not reached. The potential duties pose significant operational risks for Indian exporters reliant on access to the United States market.

geopolitics.headline: Azerbaijan and India to Convene Intergovernmental Meeting in Delhi
geopolitics.text: Azerbaijan and India are set to hold their next intergovernmental commission meeting in New Delhi to expand bilateral trade and economic ties. The upcoming talks reflect India's diplomatic strategy to strengthen commercial channels and regional cooperation across Eurasia.
